remarks: Opportunity awaits in this charming & classic New England style professional building!! Currently used as an established Law firm resting on a corner lot with private 10-space parking lot, 8 offices, 4.5 bathrooms, 2 conference rooms, 7 workstations, work/copy room, utility room, dumb waiter servicing all 4 floors, ADL elevator from parking lot to main floor., walk-out lower level with storage, work area, dining area, kitchen & bathroom. This building can easily be converted into a mixed-use office in addition to the 3rd floor as an apartment space. Fantastic location with rt. 95, downtown, shopping, dining, yacht club, golfing, parks & NYC, Hartford nearby with Providence & Boston a short distance away.
